subject: Third-party processing certification and transition plan
messages:
From: EdgeStream Compliance <compliance@edgestream.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acabank.com
Date: 2025-10-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: updated processors, export paths, and attestation for ACABank RFP

Hi Marissa,

ACABank’s procurement team is close to finalizing the contract and they've asked for an updated list of processors/subprocessors that EdgeStream will use when processing ACABank traffic via Redwood. Specifically they need:

- A flat inventory of subprocessors (name, country, purpose, data types processed)
- Evidence of any KMS/HSM or encryption attestation (SCC/KMS evidence)
- Clarification on cross-border export paths (which regions/countries data may transit to)
- Confirmation of whether any processing will occur outside the US/EU (notably APAC) and for what limited duration/purpose

They've requested a response within three business days to keep the procurement timeline. If you can either provide the inventory or point us to the canonical document we should reference (Drive link or signed attestation), that would be great.

We can pull the list from your DPA annex if easier — ACABank just needs the snapshot tied to the current release (they want the effective date on the inventory).

Thanks,
Leah Park
EdgeStream Compliance
compliance@edgestream.io

Attachments requested: sample_subprocessor_template.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: EdgeStream Compliance <compliance@edgestream.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-12T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated processors, export paths, and attestation for ACABank RFP

Hi Leah,

Thanks for the heads-up and the timeline. We can turn this around. Internal plan: Kimberly will pull the latest subprocessor inventory and the KMS attestation; Naomi will confirm cross-border routes and note any short-term processing exceptions. We'll aim to send a consolidated package by end of day Thursday (2025-10-16) to meet the three-business-day ask — is that acceptable to ACABank?

A couple quick clarifications:
- Are they requesting only processors that will handle ACABank production data, or do they also want dev/test environments included?
- Do they want per-country links for each processor (we can add a column for country of processing and whether the vendor uses cloud provider egress that could transit third countries)?

I'll follow up once we have the CSV and attestation PDF compiled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Partner Risk & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-13T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated processors, export paths, and attestation for ACABank RFP

Marissa / Kim —

Noted. Quick internal checklist for the response package:

1) Subprocessor inventory CSV: columns = vendor_name, service_role, primary_country, secondary_countries, data_types (tokens, logs, telemetry), production_only (Y/N), effective_date, contractual_clause_ref
2) KMS/HSM evidence: current attestation PDF + statement of key custody model (Redwood-managed, customer-managed, hybrid)
3) Export path summary: bullet list (e.g., US -> EU via GCP us-east1 -> eu-west1; no long-term processing in APAC except temporary caching in SG for edge performance)
4) Exceptions: any temporary/short-term processors (dates, justification, mitigation)

Edge notes: ACABank will likely want the effective_date stamped and a short paragraph we can paste into their procurement form confirming Redwood/EdgeStream responsibility split.

I'll prepare the export path bullets and draft the paste-in paragraph; Kim, can you pull the CSV + attestation by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Security & Privacy Operations
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: EdgeStream Compliance <compliance@edgestream.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated processors, export paths, and attestation for ACABank RFP

Leah / ACABank team, Marissa, Naomi —

Attached: edgestream_subprocessor_inventory.csv (snapshot effective 2025-10-15) and edgestream_scc_kms_attestation.pdf. Key points summary below for the procurement form:

- Inventory snapshot effective: 2025-10-15
- Production-only processors included; dev/test rows are marked separately in the CSV with production_only = N
- KMS: Customer keys are supported via Redwood-managed KMS with optional customer-managed keys (CMK) for Dedicated/Private customers; attestation attached (SCC/KMS)
- Export paths: Primary routing for ACABank production will remain US -> EU (us-east1 -> eu-west1). EdgeStream may use transient caching nodes in Singapore for sub-1hr caches to improve latency for APAC customers — these caches do not persist PII and are explicitly listed in the CSV under temporary_processors with start/end dates.
- Short-term exception: a temporary telemetry aggregator in SG (temporary_processor_id: SG-TEL-001) is active 2025-09-01 through 2026-01-31 for performance testing. Mitigations: data minimization, retention <24 hours, and strict ACLs.

DocuSign: we've included a signed attestation link for the KMS evidence (DocuSign:0a9b-ecd4-21).

If ACABank needs a one-page paste-ready statement, here's a short draft you can use in their procurement portal: 

"Redwood Inference, in partnership with EdgeStream, provides the attached subprocessor inventory (effective 2025-10-15) and KMS attestation. Production processing for ACABank is routed primarily between US and EU regions via standard cloud peering. Temporary caching in Singapore for latency optimization is documented and mitigated as described in the attached CSV. Redwood and EdgeStream accept responsibility as reflected in the DPA annex and attached attestations."

Please let me know if you'd like additional country-by-country transit maps; otherwise we can escalate to legal for a DPA addendum if ACABank requires contract text changes.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Attachments: edgestream_subprocessor_inventory.csv, edgestream_scc_kms_attestation.pdf
